gbm_population_evidence.quote: Confirmed diagnosis of glioblastoma based on histopathological or molecular analysis of biopsy after surgery, or suspected of glioblastoma based on medical imaging.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DIAGNOSTIC_TEST] Extended MRI: The MRI protocol for every clinical follow-up MRI scan is extended with 15 minutes to add the APTw-CEST scan.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Scheduled to undergo radiotherapy or combined chemo-and radiotherapy

coder_notes: Imaging-only diagnostic study (APTw-CEST MRI); phase NA. No drug registered as an intervention. FET-PET is mentioned as additional imaging (added to standard of care only at LUMC) but is not a registered intervention, so not listed (R9). APTw-CEST is an imaging marker, not a molecular biomarker.
